lines.en: Lia, you have a violin case! Did you use to play an instrument?

lines.en: Yes, I did. I used to play the violin every evening.

lines.en: Really? Did you use to practise a lot? I hated practising.
lines.pt: Sério? Você praticava muito? Eu odiava praticar.

lines.en: What did you use to play? Classical pieces?

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.
solo: Pergunte por que o erro acontece em português e como evitar.
group: Compare erro e forma natural: Did you used to play? → Did you use to play? | Do you use to play? → Did you use to play? | Yes, I used. → Yes, I did..
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

facts.label: Perguntas com used to
facts.sub: Did + sujeito + use to + verbo base pergunta sobre hábitos do passado. Respostas curtas: Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.

facts.label: Respostas curtas
facts.sub: Responda com did ou didn’t: Yes, I did. No, I didn’t. Depois pode completar: I used to play the violin every evening.

facts.label: Palavras de música
facts.sub: Violin, drums, piano e orchestra são úteis. Practise é o verbo para treinar, e rehearse é para ensaiar antes de tocar com outras pessoas.

pages.title: A music room · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy evening in a music room in Glasgow. An old piano stands near the window. Lia opens a case with a violin inside. Her friend Abe looks at it with a smile. They both studied music as children. Now Abe wants to ask about the past.

“Lia, you have a violin case! Did you use to play an instrument?” says Abe. “Yes, I did. I used to play the violin every evening.” says Lia. “Really? Did you use to practise a lot? I hated practising.” says Abe.
